desc:
👋 Welcome to Fishing a Fish!

💵 Scales and Pearls generate while you are offline!

How to Play:
🐟 Use your Fishing Rod and click on the water to begin catching Fish
🫧 Place the Fish you catch in Tanks so they start producing Scales and Pearls!
🍀 Upgrade your Stats and drink Potions to gain even more luck!
⚪ Upgrade your Tanks and your base to produce even more Scales and Pearls!
🧬 Collect rare Leviathans and mutations

🔥 Collect the rarest Leviathans and get the best mutations on them to climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
